source.author: cic
source.text: quoniamque ita ratio comparata est vitae naturaeque nostrae, ut alia aetas oriatur, maxime quidem optandum est ut cum aequalibus possis, quibuscum tamquam e carceribus emissus sis, cum isdem ad calcem, ut dicitur, pervenire.
source.text_original: quoniamque ita ratio comparata est vitae naturaeque nostrae, ut alia aetas oriatur, maxime quidem optandum est ut cum aequalibus possis, quibuscum tamquam e carceribus emissus sis, cum isdem ad calcem, ut dicitur, pervenire.
source.text_english: And since the course of life and our nature is arranged in such a way that one age arises after another, it is most to be wished indeed that you may be able to reach the finish line with your equals, with those with whom, so to speak, you have been let loose from the starting gates, and with the same companions arrive at the goal, as they say.

reuse.author: hier
reuse.text: Coepisse multorum est, ad calcem peruenisse paucorum.
reuse.text_original: Coepisse multorum est, ad calcem peruenisse paucorum.
reuse.text_english: Many have begun; few have reached the finish.
